title: oven-roasted light vietnamese paprika noodles
description: sweet and light vietnamese dish featuring paprika, ovo-vegetarian-friendly, ideal for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion

ingredients.name: copper mug noodle block
ingredients.notes: preferably made from buckwheat or rice flour

ingredients.name: sliced paprika
ingredients.notes: use a sweet or bell paprika

ingredients.name: tandoor spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most indian or middle eastern grocery stores

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.notes: sweet or bell paprika, for added color

ingredients.name: chicken bouillon
ingredients.notes: vegetarian-friendly option, omit for o-vegetarian-friendly option

ingredients.name: beef broth
ingredients.notes: not recommended, omit for o-vegetarian-friendly option

instructions: brush the copper mug with 1 tbsp of vegetable oil
add 4 oz of tandoor-spiced tofu to the copper mug
add 1/2 cup of sliced red onion to the copper mug
add 1/2 cup of sliced carrots to the copper mug
add 1/4 cup of sliced paprika to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of grated ginger to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of ground ginger to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of tandoor spice mix to the copper mug
add 2 tbsp of soy sauce to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of dark soy sauce to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of sesame oil to the copper mug
add 2 tbsp of lime juice to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of fish sauce to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of salt to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of sugar to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of rice vinegar to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of chili flakes to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of lemon zest to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of black pepper to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of cayenne pepper to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of oregano to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of basil to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of kaffir lime leaves to the copper mug
add 1 tsp of koji to the copper mug
add 4 cups of chicken bouillon to the copper mug
add 4 cups of vegetable broth to the copper mug
add 1 cup of coconut milk to the copper mug
add 1 cup of evaporated milk to the copper mug
add 1 cup of almond milk to the copper mug
add 1 cup of cashew cream to the copper mug
add 2 tsp of cornstarch to the copper mug
cover the copper mug with a lid or foil
preheat the oven to 400 f (200 c)
roast the noodles in the preheated oven for 15 minutes
remove the roasted noodles from the oven and let cool slightly
slice the noodles into individual portions
garnish the noodles with toasted sesame seeds and scallions
garnish the noodles with toasted peanuts and scallions
garnish the noodles with chopped cilantro and scallions
garnish the noodles with chopped scallions and lemon zest
garnish the noodles with toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions
garnish the noodles with toasted peanuts and chopped scallions
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
